add_rc_deps(hh.rc ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/hh.ico)

# hh.exe is all Rust (hh-rust) and cargo links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/hh-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C stays on disk, uncompiled.
# The translated C, kept on disk:
# main.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/hh-rust/src/hh/main.rs)
# The resources are the one thing cmake still compiles, in this OBJECT library
# whose windres command the cargo link replays.
add_library(hh_res OBJECT hh.rc)
target_include_directories(hh_res PRIVATE ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR})
add_cargo_module(hh hh-cargo hh.exe
    KIND win32exe
    BODY_CRATE hh-rust
    DESTINATION reactos
    EXTRA_DEPENDS hh_res)
